prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, game sprite sheet. Reference contains an individual Joseon-style painted cat. Preserve that exact cat's fur markings, colors, small almond eyes, delicate historical Korean ink fur strokes and natural head proportions. Produce ONLY FOUR SEATED IDLE animation frames of the same cat. Exactly 2 columns x 2 rows in a square canvas, each cell independently contains ONE COMPLETE CAT. Cat is SITTING on its haunches, front paws resting together on ground, hind legs folded, tail curled by body. Face three-quarter LEFT. Frames: attentive seated, slight breathing, blink closed eyes, eyes open small ear twitch. Identical scale and paw baseline in all four cells. NO standing pose, no walking, no running. Keep at least 12% transparent gutter on every side of each cat, including whiskers and tail, no overlap. Genuine transparent alpha, no background, paper rectangle, ground shadow, labels, lines or extra objects. This is authentic fine ink and light pigment Joseon animal painting, not modern round-eyed cute illustration.
